steps.what: Identify the malfunctioning equipment and determine the actual compatible replacement part and required quantity
inputs: actual malfunctioning equipment and fault evidence
actual equipment parts documentation and configuration
outputs: technician-checked equipment identity, compatible part and quantity

steps.what: Find and verify the actual approved supplier, part reference, current price and availability in the purchasing catalogue
inputs: technician-checked equipment identity, compatible part and quantity
actual approved supplier catalogue and current purchasing records
outputs: technician-verified actual supplier/part offer and availability gaps

steps.what: Prepare the actual replacement-part order using selected catalogue fields and check the complete part, quantity, price, delivery address and supplier destination
inputs: technician-verified actual supplier/part offer and availability gaps
actual authorized delivery address and purchasing requirements
outputs: exact checked final replacement-part order and supplier destination

steps.what: Review the exact completed replacement-part order and supplier destination against actual purchasing authority and authorize that version
inputs: exact checked final replacement-part order and supplier destination
actual purchasing authority and budget requirements
outputs: authorization of the exact final replacement-part order and supplier destination

steps.what: Order replacement parts for the malfunctioning equipment by sending only the exact authorized order to the actual supplier
inputs: exact checked final replacement-part order and supplier destination
authorization of the exact final replacement-part order and supplier destination
outputs: actual replacement-part order sent to supplier

tasks.design: Configure native equipment-part catalogue navigation and selected-offer field reuse in {PROCUREMENT}. The technician verifies compatibility and the full order; the actual purchasing approver reviews the completed final version before its separate supplier send, with no inferred approval or substituted part.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated catalogue searches and order-field transcription can surround actual replacement-part ordering.
tasks.enabler_now: Native purchasing catalogues and order forms can reuse checked offer fields.
tasks.still_hard: Compatibility, current offer validity and actual purchasing authority require people.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize an apparently equivalent part that changes the measurement equipment's suitability.

reach.task: Authorize the exact completed order within actual purchasing authority
reach.learn: Check final part, cost and destination

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4 with purchasing and equipment catalogue owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native purchasing catalogue links and field reuse can reduce order preparation while part compatibility and purchasing approval remain human work.

assumptions: This is an actual order requiring the stated purchasing approval. Equipment owners supply real documentation; purchasing maintains real offers/addresses. The technician determines compatibility in s1 and checks/captures offer/order fields in s2/s3.

Missing compatibility evidence, stale offers or unapproved suppliers require manual resolution. No part, price, stock level or address is invented. Native configuration first; equivalent existing reuse removes the gain.

Shares 35/20/24/20/1 are unmeasured active effort including 20 other-role approval units. Focal baseline is 80; retained focal effort is 35 + 14 + 14.4 + 1 = 64.4. Gross focal saving is 19.5 percent; 2 hours of catalogue/form upkeep per 100 focal baseline hours leaves 17.5 net.

Approver work is fully retained and excluded from focal savings. Approval follows the exact final order; changed content or destination returns to s3/s4. Negligible supplier send remains fully retained and earns no saving.
No hidden requisition save, second supplier message, payment or automatic substitution is promised.
unknowns: Actual catalogue integration, approval requirements and repeated fields
research_questions: Measure actual catalogue/order handling separately from compatibility and purchasing authorization.

already_counted.description: Actual compatibility, offer checks, full order preparation/checking and final send remain.

incremental.description: Maintain equipment-part links and selected-offer field mappings.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked final replacement-part order and supplier destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 17.5 percent focal net, conditional on actual repeated catalogue/order work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Establish actual calibration requirements, measurand, range, uncertainty needs and measurement-standard suitability
inputs: actual measurement device and calibration requirements
actual measurement-standard evidence and relevant analyses
outputs: technician-defined actual method requirements and unresolved metrology inputs

steps.what: Develop new calibration methods or techniques based on measurement science, analyses and actual calibration requirements
inputs: technician-defined actual method requirements and unresolved metrology inputs
actual measurement science, device behavior and analysis evidence
outputs: technician-authored calibration method logic, calculations, constraints and validation questions

steps.what: Prepare and correct the working calibration-method text from the technician's actual method logic and supplied evidence
inputs: technician-authored calibration method logic, calculations, constraints and validation questions
actual approved method-document structure

loop.purpose: Express the technician's already-authored method logic clearly
loop.input: Actual authored method logic and evidence plus existing document structure
loop.output: Proposed working method text with source-linked assumptions and gaps
loop.check: Technician checks every operation, condition, sequence, limitation and provenance against the actual method logic
loop.stop: Missing method decision or unsupported operation returns to manual writing; no calculation or validation result is generated
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed headings do not express variable method reasoning; calculations and metadata remain outside the semantic step

steps.what: Check the complete working calibration method against actual requirements, analyses, uncertainty assumptions and intended development revision
inputs: technician-corrected working calibration-method document
technician-authored calibration method logic, calculations, constraints and validation questions
outputs: exact checked working calibration-method document and internal development destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked working calibration method in its internal development revision, pending actual validation and operational release
inputs: exact checked working calibration-method document and internal development destination

tasks.design: Use the native method-document structure in {DOCS} and a bounded prose step only after the technician has developed the actual calibration logic and calculations. The technician checks the complete working method and saves it in {OPS_SYSTEM}, calibration document control; no validation result or operational release is inferred.
tasks.previous_blocker: Expressing actual method reasoning in a working document adds writing around metrology development.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can organize supplied reasoning under existing method headings.
tasks.still_hard: Measurement principles, uncertainty, standard suitability and actual method validity remain metrology work.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize an apparently clear method that does not meet the real measurement requirement.

ambition.what: Reduce wording effort around actual method development.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4 with metrology and method-document control owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded drafting can organize supplied calibration-method reasoning, while scientific method design, calculations and validation remain metrology work.

assumptions: Actual device/standard owners supply requirements and evidence. The technician captures requirements in s1 and produces all real method logic and calculations in s2 before prose assistance; no ready structured method is assumed.
Native headings first. No model invents operations, uncertainties, measurement values or validation outcomes; unsupported content stops for manual writing and all retained statements are checked.
Shares 30/40/20/9/1 are unmeasured active development effort. Gross saving 4 minus 1.5 hours of draft-output/source upkeep leaves 2.5 net. Negligible save is fully retained.

The actual deliverable is a working method, pending real validation and release under the organization's existing process. No experiment, validation certificate or operational deployment is promised or silently omitted from a claim of released readiness.
Final complete method checking is ordinary development work in s4; edits invalidate the gate.
unknowns: Actual method-document writing workload and release/validation process
research_questions: Measure prose correction effort separately from actual method design and uncertainty analysis.

already_counted.description: Actual requirement capture, metrology development, prose correction and complete method checking remain.

incremental.description: Maintain source-bound drafting instructions and check unsupported method wording.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked working calibration-method document and internal development destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 2.5 percent net; actual method science and validation are not automated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Attend training on calibration tools and methods

inputs: actual calibration learning needs and approved course/event catalogue
actual session details and access requirements
outputs: technician-selected actual relevant training session and learning questions

steps.what: Attend actual conferences, workshops or other training sessions to learn new tools or methods, ask questions and undertake actual practice where included
inputs: technician-selected actual relevant training session and learning questions
actual instructor content, demonstrations and practice opportunities
outputs: actual attended learning, questions, practice and supplied completion evidence

steps.what: Enter actual attendance/completion evidence in the existing learning record after the session and check the complete entry and destination
inputs: actual attended learning, questions, practice and supplied completion evidence
actual learner/session identifiers and learning record requirements
outputs: exact checked actual training-completion record and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual training-completion record in the intended internal learning revision
inputs: exact checked actual training-completion record and internal destination

tasks.design: Configure native catalogue filters and retained learner/session fields in {LMS}. The technician attends and practices personally, then captures/checks only actual completion evidence before saving; attendance is not inferred from enrolment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual course selection and required learning entries may repeat catalogue navigation and fixed identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native LMS filters and context can retain existing learner/course identities.
tasks.still_hard: Learning, practice and deciding how a new method applies remain technician work.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize the limits of a demonstrated technique before applying it to actual calibration.

ambition.what: Reduce context around actual required training records.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 with learning administration and staff consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native LMS filters and session context can reduce course/record handling while actual training and practice remain human work.

assumptions: This is an actual training episode with a required existing learning entry. The catalogue owner supplies real sessions; instructors supply actual completion evidence, and the technician captures/checks it in s3 after actual attendance/practice in s2.
No invented completion, certification or learning score is generated. Missing evidence requires manual resolution. No registration send or enrolment action is silently promised.

Native catalogue/context first; equivalent existing configuration removes the gain. Shares 15/75/9/1 are unmeasured active effort; gross saving 3 + 1.8 = 4.8 minus 1 hour of filter/default upkeep leaves 3.8 net.
Negligible save is fully retained. Ordinary final record checking in s3 follows completion evidence; edits invalidate the gate.
unknowns: Actual learning-entry requirement and existing native course filters
research_questions: Observe repeated course/learner fields separately from actual learning and evidence checking.

already_counted.description: Course relevance checks, actual learning/practice and completion evidence capture remain.

incremental.description: Maintain native learning filters and fixed context defaults.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked actual training-completion record and internal destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 3.8 percent net; actual attendance and learning remain.

tasks.design: Configure native checked standard-element and drawing-profile reuse in {OPS_SYSTEM}, mechanical CAD. The technician devises and draws the actual development plan, checks all dimensions and interfaces and saves the final internal revision; no automatic fabrication or calibration-method release is promised.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated standard fixture elements and drawing setup add handling around actual plan development.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parametric elements and drafting profiles can reuse fixed verified conventions.
tasks.still_hard: Measurement interfaces, tolerances and device suitability require actual engineering decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a fixture arrangement that makes the measurement unreliable despite fitting mechanically.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated drawing setup around actual device plans.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 with engineering library and metrology owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native CAD standard elements and drawing profiles can reduce repeated plan setup while actual device design and measurement-interface verification remain human work.

assumptions: Equipment/design owners supply actual interfaces and requirements; the technician captures them in s1, produces the concept/calculations in s2 and builds/checks the actual plan in s3/s4. No complete structured device model is assumed.
Reuse only checked applicable standard elements; missing dimensions or unsuitable interfaces require actual manual engineering. Native library first; equivalent existing reuse removes the gain.

Shares 25/30/34/10/1 are provisional unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 10.2 minus 2 hours of library/profile upkeep leaves 8.2 net. Existing CAD calculation runtime earns no new saving and negligible save is fully retained.
Final full plan checking is ordinary development work in s4; edits invalidate the gate. Actual fabrication, validation and release are separate work and no readiness claim for those is made.
unknowns: Actual repeatable standard drawing elements and existing CAD configuration
research_questions: Measure repeated drawing setup separately from custom fixture geometry and metrology decisions.
